Local evidence and production gates

Evidence is split into local functional proof, package/signature proof, native platform support, and protected production promotion. Passing one does not imply the others.

Machine-readable record. staging-evidence.json carries the same public, source-free status. It contains no local paths, credentials, vault coordinates, or private engine source.

Converged RC package proof

The local archive dc7d54bf894966b935c8e2d44868c5caa4571b3fdfabd6765672486a95eb9d9a, manifest a997d4679f54125bc618c412bca5b877afc83273730cca5a0c9553a29da88e04, and combined proof 9f9258988e2f7dd5c1cf380405eee9081bc6de33f038a4bdb4d54600b7f6b1aa bind the full npm/Python SDK facades to their exact macOS arm64 native companions. The facades carry public client code, installed-payload resolution and both launchers; the companions carry manager 4fecd84584ed50dacde0677a9aba18c8a44ce6a58ea499e701e2c6dcd1c05b3e and engine 988192ac9677d5dd55a3642b2da493a0806bb860b5b3c0f509b37ddadee08825 plus contract a2357ed6c00e3e143d08581590571447e31d24fd0e7d2466d28a211a0515c75e. The signature envelope 6dd03a82e4688413c438a8ca8682b20e3a8886895ba2059a22881458127f843e uses only a checked-in TEST-ONLY trust root. This closes the local package-shape convergence, not the protected production gates.

Approval and credential gates

  • Approval of a license for the public manager, wrappers, integrations, and skill.
  • Approval of terms for original documentation and an engine object-code EULA.
  • Staging/production OIDC configuration and private control-plane deployment evidence.
  • Production signing/notarization identities, registry/CDN credentials, and native platform runners.
  • A separate final approval for package publication, production login, and Pages promotion.
